source: due2-native: an odrl:constraint on the Policy, which the vocabulary allows and the Information Model gives no meaning (issue #93)
notes: Authored for due2. The policy is valid ODRL 2.2 and passes odrl22-shape.ttl; the rejection is due2's. It is the one placement that the vocabulary allows and due2 still rejects, and the place OVAL's refinement_instead_of_constraint2 would reach if its odrl:refinement were renamed odrl:constraint (oval-refinement-on-policy). The same condition on the Rule is admitted.

expected_rejection.why: The Policy <http://example.com/policy:policy-constraint> carries an odrl:constraint. The ODRL vocabulary admits one there (Vocabulary §3.14.2), but the Information Model gives it no meaning: a Policy's shared properties are Rule components (IM §2.1, §2.7.1). Normalisation rejects it as an unsupported construct in stage 1 (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3), so W1 rejects the policy rather than guess at a reading.
